description: Price series of an identifier between two dates (weekly since 2017 for the Valencia region, since 2019 for the national averages and since 2005 for the Lonja de Salamanca; daily since October 2026 for diesel). If there are more points than max_puntos, it returns the most recent ones (by default 104, at most 520); the whole series is in the linked CSV. Points are figures, not weeks or days (out of season there is no price): for a period, use desde and hasta. — La serie de precios entre dos fechas.

max_puntos.description: Optional: maximum number of points to return; if the range has more, the most recent ones (104 by default, at most 520).
